text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(I have all the info on the contenders right in the palm of my hand.
Both pace and race development are just as expected.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Thanks to them, the simulations were supposed to be perfect.
...And yet...!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ghhhaaaaaahh!!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Eep—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh...! Bad, bad, bad!
Get out of the way! Move, pleeease!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (Wait, what is happening here...?! Everyone's in total chaos...! In a situation like this—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (—I'm getting swallowed up...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Stop it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (—The race is being repainted in her colors.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Don't you dare take it away!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A truly brilliant victory in the Satsuki Sho!
Satono Crown finishes in 1st place!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Holy crap...! This race is definitely going down in history...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Congrats!! Satono Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Blessings flew all around. Deafening cheers echoed.
Yet, at the center of it all, Satono Crown—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer..., I...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Did I... win...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to comprehend a path to victory that lay beyond her understanding,
her face showed traces of confusion and exhaustion.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...What is it, Crown?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Just what on earth did you do?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I lost to you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Unable to seize the throne of the strongest,
I yielded the way forward to you."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Don't play dumb!
Ever since you entered the 4th corner, you—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Would finding an excuse
change today's result?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Nay, it changes nothing! You won, and I lost!
That fact will never waver!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I will beat you. In the next Derby.
Without fail, I will beat you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
What... What is this, what is this?!!
I am—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I was supposed to have won...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown's words fail to reach Duramente.
The stage shifts onward to the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).
